P0 isolation + fix plan.

Slice 1: isolate the persistence break, then fix + regression-gate.

Isolation (bead ordered):
1. toron MCP tool direct (toron_file_reservation_paths) with two distinct project-agent keys -> check_file_reservation_conflicts: MCP path persist+conflict?
2. If MCP works -> flywheel mail locks wrapper bug. If MCP fails -> toron-core persistence/projection (resolved_leases/collect_replay dropping held 30031s).
3. Check resolve_coordinate (one-coordinate-per-agent?) + d-tag shape + bus publish/replay path for flywheel-registered agent keys (key divergence hypothesis).

Fix direction (after isolation): ensure every acquire path persists the held 30031 to the store conflict_view reads; hard-block cross-agent exclusive overlap. Four-path consistency gate: flywheel mail locks + coalition reserve + toron CLI + MCP.

Locks: toron-core mailbox/{reservations,replay}, bus/addressable, toron-mcp tools, flywheel mail_shim + backend/toron. Files in ~/workspace/toron + ~/workspace/flywheel.
